frontend.i-inputs: Free-space frame and obstacle, sensor marker and sensing rays, odometry trace, start/goal path, constraint arc, floor plan, labels.
frontend.ii-reasoning: Visibility graph, Voronoi/skeleton, cell decomposition, roadmap/tree, graph-search weights and selected route, hierarchy graphs, frames, formula and captions.
frontend.iii-outputs: Collision-free path, topological map, multi-agent time/vertex diagram, coverage/sweep path, frames and labels.
